sections.Profile:
The "Roller Disco" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in 1980, is a solid-state game designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. This widebody pinball machine, similar in size to the "Genie" model, features vibrant and colorful artwork that captures the essence of the disco era.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Rollerskating, Good Times, Sports, Original Theme, Skating, Solid State, Widebody, Colorful, Music, 1980s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
